independent_computation.step_1_identify_the_only_raw-damage-movi: The scenario pairs Black Cleaver with Bloodsong. Black Cleaver's Carve (S2) is armor REDUCTION: per S4/S5 it only enters the mitigation multiplier m(R)=100/(100+R), which multiplies raw damage; it can never change the raw (pre-mitigation) damage of an instance. Bloodsong's Expose Weakness (S1) is the only mechanic in this pairing that scales a damage instance itself: the debuffed target takes +8% (melee holder) / +5% (ranged holder) increased damage FROM ALL SOURCES for 4 s -- i.e. a cross-participant multiplier that a coupled 'roster' scenario is exactly the place to exercise.
independent_computation.step_2_where_the_amp_must_land_in_the_le: Mitigation is linear in raw (S4), so amp-then-mitigate == mitigate-then-amp for the final number; the amp factor must therefore appear on exactly one of the two ledger fields. For the post-mitigation total to carry the +8%, the recorded raw_damage of an instance aimed at an Expose-Weakness'd target must be the amplified instance. A raw_damage leaf that omits the amp under-reports the instance by the full 8%.
independent_computation.step_3_solve_for_the_unamplified_instanc: Let U be the unamplified raw damage; the golden stores 1-decimal values. Require round(U,1)=94.1 (old leaf) AND round(1.08*U,1)=101.7 (new leaf). From the amped side: 1.08*U in [101.65, 101.75) => U in [94.12037, 94.21296). From the old side: U in [94.05, 94.15). Intersection = [94.12037, 94.15) -- NON-EMPTY, so 94.1 and 101.7 are exactly the unamplified/amplified pair of one and the same damage instance under a multiplier of 1.08.
independent_computation.step_4_worked_example: U = 94.13 -> round(U,1) = 94.1 (the old leaf) ; U * 1.08 = 101.6604 -> round(,1) = 101.7 (the new leaf). Observed ratio 101.7 / 94.1 = 1.08077, i.e. +8.08%, within the rounding band of an exact +8%.
independent_computation.step_5_rule_out_the_ranged_branch: If the Bloodsong holder were ranged the multiplier would be 1.05 (S1/S3) and the amplified leaf would be 98.8 (94.12..94.15 * 1.05 = 98.83..98.86), which is neither stored value. The engine's new value matches the melee branch exactly.
independent_computation.step_6_rule_out_the_alternatives: (a) Black Cleaver stack-count model (0.8*max_stacks vs the closed-form Cesaro mean C - C(C-1)/(2h), S5) moves post-mitigation damage only -- it cannot move a raw_damage leaf. (b) A partial amp (only one addend of the instance amplified) is impossible: 94.1 + 0.08*B = 101.7 needs B = 95 > 94.1, so the WHOLE instance was scaled uniformly. (c) The instance is not the Spellblade proc itself (100% base AD, S1): per docs/math-foundations.md stats are integer-rounded before damage, so a pure base-AD proc raw would be an integer, and no champion in data/champions.json has base AD in the required window [94.120, 94.150) at any level 1-20 (nearest: Aphelios L18 = 94.100, Dr. Mundo L15 = 94.1625, both outside). So the self-amp question ('does the attack that applies Expose Weakness amplify itself?') does not arise for this leaf.
independent_computation.conclusion: The correct raw_damage for this event is the +8%-amplified instance, 101.7. The old 94.1 is the same instance with Bloodsong's Expose Weakness amplification omitted.

residual_assumptions: The Bloodsong holder in this roster is MELEE (S1/S3 give 8% melee / 5% ranged). The observed multiplier is 1.08, i.e. the melee branch; if the scenario's holder were ranged, the correct value would be ~98.8 and both stored values would be wrong. Scenario composition is not visible from the permitted evidence tree (data/ + docs/math-foundations.md only), but Black Cleaver + Bloodsong is a melee pairing and the ratio matches 8% to within rounding.
Event 59's target is an enemy champion inside the 4 s Expose Weakness window (S1 conditions the debuff on 'If the target is a champion'). Event timing is not visible from the evidence tree.

data/runes.json 'Press the Attack' carries an independently cached 8% amp (S6). Under that alternative source the numeric conclusion is identical (x1.08), but PTA's cached text amps only the holder ('grant you'), whereas S1 amps 'all sources' -- the roster-coupled reading that the scenario name and the /coupled_scenarios/ path point at.
